findings.text: follow-on: the fragment states the head gate as 167 passed but does not name the revision the log's header carries; gate-head-resumed.log records working-tree(base=f82b43b1c), two commits before the reviewed head 2ebbb932b, so a reader cannot tie a passing gate to the committed head.

follow-on: RACING_WINNER_WAIT_SECONDS is now CLAIM_GRACE_FLOOR_SECONDS and is still re-exported through reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1973, while no caller reads it as a bound; a reader may take it for the operative grace it no longer is.

follow-on: the receipt fallback in recent_claim_grace_seconds and the run ids _recent_run_names returns walk run_store.db and the live pointers, but no test exercises the indexed branch — the two derivation tests read the summary file and the explicit-root receipt path instead.

follow-on: the first head gate (gate-head.log, EXIT=1) aborted on an ImportError because the module still imported the removed _CLAIM_LAUNCH_OBSERVED_SECONDS, so the committed arm was not runnable at 7e33a7e34 and only the resumed arm is a readable head measurement.

item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit against base e0497bd71; the production change is dispatch_claims.py plus dispatch_launch.py and nothing falls outside the declared paths.
item_verdicts.done_when: No literal launch distribution remains in source; twenty 8 s intervals and twenty 24 s intervals give 12 s and 36 s; nineteen intervals give the 5 s floor; warm-dispatch-driver.log records added_median_ms=0.028166, under the 50 ms bound.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is met — the racing-winner claim grace is derived at dispatch from recorded launch intervals. The frozen 20-value tuple is gone and claim_grace_seconds remains the derivation.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; status complete; its baseline_suite and after_suite blocks reconcile with gate-base.log (161 passed, 2 failed) and gate-head-resumed.log (167 passed, EXIT=0).
item_verdicts.write_paths: All six changed paths are inside the granted scope — the three dispatch paths at dispatch plus the two test modules the resume advice added.

justifications.durability: negative-control.log (EXIT=1) reddens test_two_recorded_launch_distributions_produce_distinct_graces at 33 versus 12 when the frozen deadline is restored, and the new tests are isolated through the autouse temporary RECKON_HOME and monkeypatched crew_home/runs_dir; but the indexed receipt branch reads the real run_store.db and no test exercises it.
justifications.evidence: gate-head-resumed.log's header names working-tree(base=f82b43b1c) rather than the committed head 2ebbb932b, and the first head gate aborted on a stale-test ImportError, so the recorded 167-pass is not tied to the committed revision by the log alone; an independent run of the three changed modules at 2ebbb932b passes 15/15.
justifications.fit: the additions follow the module's docstring-and-dict idiom and reuse _pointer_lock, _write_json and parse_utc; no name carries a plan, sprint or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: all three items land: claim.json records the registration instant, recent_claim_grace_seconds derives the grace from recent intervals with a 128-entry bound and a 30 s process cache, and the frozen tuple is removed — but RACING_WINNER_WAIT_SECONDS now equals the floor and stays exported though nothing reads it as a bound, and the indexed receipt fallback is untested.
justifications.reuse: the interval-to-grace decision (len >= 20 ? claim_grace_seconds : floor) is written twice, in the summary branch and the receipt branch, and _recent_run_names re-derives worker-record discovery that recovery and promotion already own.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff of e0497bd71..2ebbb932b is inside the granted write paths — the three dispatch paths and the fragment were granted at dispatch, and the two test modules were added by the recorded resume advice.
